{{Quote|It's a ''Jedi Knight''! How did he get here so ''quickly''?|The Banking Clan representative|<ref name="Foreclosure">{{TCWComicCite|6.7|Foreclosure}}</ref>}}
A '''Banking Clan representative''' accompanied [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] to visit the [[Quingarus Deluxe Droid Systems Factory]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], this man and [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] visited [[Quingarus]], threatening him with producing [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] for them to pay off his debt. When he refused, the pair attacked him with a [[Upgraded battle droid|new model]] of battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]], only being stopped by the intervention of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. The representatives fled the scene, but promised revenge if Quingarus didn't pay up.
